scope: All 1206 EmbSpatial-Bench close/far rows from the sealed geometry diagnosis and 96 of the same rows for the marker-order control.
models: frozen MoGe-2 with cached aligned pointmaps
extra_audit: Reverse letter assignments on the fixed 96-question panel, retaining the same highlighted shapes, positions and original XYZ.

controls.region_depth: HiSpatial binds by mark ID. Mean valid Z in selected, 3D-consistent mask.
controls.window_depth: Same selected region and binding. Mean valid Z in its enclosing rectangular window.
controls.whole_map_depth: Highlight depth across the whole image using an aligned warm-near cool-far overlay, then run the same frozen HiSpatial on the original question.
controls.original_hispatial: Use sealed native RGB and aligned MoGe HiSpatial answers from the previous paired diagnosis.

readout: Use the minimum or maximum object-level depth only when every concrete choice binds to a distinct region and both depth readouts have a unique extreme. Use original HiSpatial as fallback. Unknown is kept as an explicit unbound choice.
limits: The first experiment diagnoses visible-region binding and depth readout. Amodal size and pose are outside the evaluation. All labels, target boxes and correctness are offline only.
